svg.aria-label: Not converted to SVG. The headline is a ransom-note paste-up: every letter is a separate scrap cut from a different source, at its own angle and size, mixed black-on-white and white-on-black. Measured, 13 of its rows share no baseline and 12 are single isolated glyphs. The lower text is font-like, but it sits on torn strips over a photocopied texture that cannot be separated from it, and the cut-up lettering is what the style is.
svg.title: Not converted to SVG — Punk Fanzine — gig poster
